items.html: And the whole ten Sefirot of Beriah were in the place which is now the ZA of Atzilut, in its ten Sefirot. And ZA and his Nukva of Atzilut were then in the place where Aba and Ima of Atzilut are now. And in this manner the worlds from Aba and Ima of Atzilut and above, up to the height of the degrees, up to the Ein Sof, were higher than their degree, which they are now; and there is no need to elaborate on them.
